entities.name: PDU session establishment
entities.description: Procedure for establishing a PDU session in a network slice to enable PDU transmission when no adequate established PDU session exists.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information used to identify a network slice.

entities.name: Data network name
entities.description: Data Network Name identifying the target data network for the PDU session.

entities.name: Allowed NSSAI
entities.description: Set of S-NSSAIs allowed in the serving PLMN or SNPN.

entities.name: Mapped S-NSSAI
entities.description: Mapped S-NSSAI value used in roaming scenarios for PDU session establishment.

entities.name: No adequate established PDU session
entities.description: Condition where there is no established PDU session suitable for the required PDU transmission.

entities.name: UE decision mechanism
entities.description: UE determines whether to establish a new PDU session or use an existing one based on URSP rules or local configuration.

entities.name: URSP rules
entities.description: UE Route Selection Policy rules used by the UE to determine PDU session selection.

relations.description: PDU session establishment procedure includes S-NSSAI as a parameter.
PDU session establishment procedure includes DNN as a parameter.
PDU session establishment is triggered when no adequate PDU session exists.
S-NSSAI used in PDU session establishment must be part of the allowed NSSAI.
In roaming scenarios, mapped S-NSSAI is included along with S-NSSAI for PDU session establishment.
UE decision to establish or use PDU session is based on URSP rules.
Condition of no adequate PDU session establishes the need for PDU session establishment procedure.
